final_response: Followed up on the customer incident and requested the missing diagnostics. Also added a note to the incident ticket.

args.comment_text: Following up with the customer/partner to request the missing diagnostics for the data export incident.

args.body:
Hi,

Following up on the data export customer incident. Could you please send over the missing diagnostics so we can continue the investigation?

Specifically, please include:
- Relevant timestamps/time window of the failed export
- Export/job IDs
- Error messages or screenshots
- Affected account/workspace details
- Any relevant logs or diagnostic bundle

Once we have these, we’ll proceed with the next step on our side.

Thanks.
